description:
Initialization: Assign tasks (descending reward, then task ID) to candidate satellite with lowest assigned duration; 
tie-break by smaller ID. Unassigned if no candidates.

Reassignment (best-improvement local search from base schedule):
- Migration: Trial unobserved-task migrations to non-owner satellites with candidates (ascending task ID, then satellite ID).
- Swap: Trial swaps between tasks on different satellites with mutual candidates (ascending task IDs).
- Acceptance: Select feasible trial with highest total reward strictly above current schedule; retain first on tie. Restart search from Migration upon acceptance.
- Termination: Stop if no move improves or timeout expires (retain best verified checkpoint).
